Barrichello's teammates who won a drivers' championship in 2000–2025 were Michael Schumacher and Jenson Button.

- **Michael Schumacher** was his Ferrari teammate from 2000 to 2005, and won the 2000–2004 titles.
- **Jenson Button** was his Honda teammate in 2006–2008 and his Brawn teammate in 2009, and won the 2009 title.
- **Nico Hülkenberg** (Williams, 2010) and **Pastor Maldonado** (Williams, 2011) never won a title.

The teammate lookups list only one teammate per season, so I went by those results. For 2000 that means Eddie Irvine does not appear, which I can't check against any other source.

ANSWER: Michael Schumacher, Jenson Button
